accepted.quote: Neither of the mining sections in this scorched-earth giveaway to polluters would bring common sense to our woefully antiquated General Mining Act of 1872.
accepted.rationale: The passage criticizes the mining provisions as a polluter giveaway that fails to reform mining law.

accepted.quote: The Boundary Waters in Northeastern Minnesota is a pristine wilderness. It is a treasure beloved by countless Americans and is the most visited Wilderness Area in the country.
accepted.rationale: The passage affirms the value of the Boundary Waters Wilderness Area in opposing mining leases nearby.

accepted.quote: the U.S. Forest Service concluded sulfide-ore copper mining--which is significantly different from the taconite mining the region is used to--could result in ``extreme'' and ``serious and irreparable harm'' in the watershed of this Wilderness Area.
accepted.rationale: The passage cites severe environmental harm to oppose sulfide-ore copper mining in the watershed.

accepted.quote: In effect, this section allows well-financed project sponsors to buy a one-year EIS (or a six-month EA) and immunity from lawsuits and judicial or administrative accountability
accepted.rationale: The passage criticizes the pay-to-play provision for undermining adequate NEPA review and accountability.
